lines.l: I can see the waves roll over me
I can be like the weeds and sway in the blue
Feet in the sand it takes a muscular hand to rip me out
Or just one sparkle can erase things I worry about
I can see the waves all over me
I can be like the weeds and sway in the blue
Beating the sand, it takes a muscular hand to rip me out
Or just one sparkle can erase things I worry about
